subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and if so under what trust and fetch policy?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the request would change that security boundary for untrusted chat content.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob image rendering and require a proxy, structured media path, or explicit opt-in design before remote images render inline.

options.title: Allow direct remote images
options.body: Accept the privacy and tracking tradeoff and update renderer behavior, CSP, sanitizer attributes, docs, tests, and browser proof together.

options.title: Route through media umbrella
options.body: Let the broader inline media issue own the remote-media policy and close or narrow this issue only after that policy is explicit.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve same-origin/data/blob image rendering and require a proxy, structured media path, or explicit opt-in design before remote images render inline.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision is primarily about the Control UI browser-fetch/CSP security policy that drobison00 most directly touched in merged history.
